name: Phone notifications dropping in
description: Phone-style notification banners drop in from the top of the frame over the speaker one after another: rounded white cards with an orange square app icon, app name, 'now', a bold title and a one-line body; each new one lands on top and pushes the earlier ones down into a stack in the upper third.
use_when: Lines about things piling up or arriving on your phone: messages, sales, new followers, comments, alerts, 'my phone kept buzzing', 'the orders started coming in', reminders you ignore.

items.help: 2-4 [{app, title, body, icon}] in arrival order (the last one ends on top). app ≤ 14 chars, title ≤ 28, body ≤ 40; icon is a GFX icon name such as chat, bell, dollar, heart, user, calendar, play, trendUp
